name: rust-nested-fqn-clean
body: Nested projects must render clean, collision-free FQNs. Because a nested package's name differs from the root's (apg-rustfrontend vs apg), the ingestor's module-prefixed FQN rendering yields disjoint namespaces with no collision. AC: the nested crate's module FQN is apg-rustfrontend and its symbols are apg-rustfrontend.*; scanning the apg repo itself triggers no ingestor FQN-collision panic and the nested module appears exactly once.
